Put wall up to 430, still above the close-below-400 exit. Bullflow agrees on CW 450/king 450, PW 400. VEX +$25.6M: post-FOMC IV drop supportive, IV spike adds selling. HOLD.
- **New entries: NONE.** GOOGL call spread has only Sentiment 2/5 (Fundamentals and Technical say no pre-earnings premium). TSLA calls: Technical conditional vs Sentiment bearish 3/5, conflicting, and TSLA is below 400. META puts: Technical + Sentiment bearish, but both want a post-Fed confirmation, and no compliant spread reaches 2:1 at natural. QQQ/AAPL conditionals unarmed. FOMC 2 PM + GOOGL/MSFT tonight.
- Post-FOMC watch (re-proposal requires a fresh chain, gex.py --check, Skeptic and Risk): META puts if ≥ 2:1 at natural and META < 631.6; TSLA 430/440C only if it closes ≥ 396 and Sentiment stops leaning bearish; QQQ < 698; AAPL ≥ 350.
- Crazy account: AMZN 252.5/265C and FSLR 175/185C 10/30 both ride 10/29 after-close earnings; decide with Risk before the 10/29 close.
- Account about $9,975 (Risk), 1 of 10 positions.

gamma.convention: Dealer GEX approximation: call GEX = +gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01, put GEX = -gamma*OI*100*S^2*0.01 ($ of delta hedging per 1% move; assumes dealers long calls / short puts, the common public convention). Positive total = dealers dampen moves (pinning); negative = dealers amplify moves.
gamma.disclaimer: Free public data; estimate only; supporting signal for PAPER trading; never places orders.
